name: spd-lib
description: SPD (Secure Packaged Data) — a compressed, post-quantum-hardened encrypted data format, portable across Node.js, browsers, Deno, and Bun. Supports chunked internet transfer, large-file streaming (>2 GB), Argon2id key derivation, XChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD, and HMAC-SHA3-512 authentication.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts --clean && tsup src/web.ts --format esm --dts --no-clean && tsup src/score.ts --format esm --dts --no-clean && tsup src/spd-encrypt-worker.ts --format esm --no-dts --no-clean --out-dir dist && tsup src/spd-inspect.ts --format esm --no-dts --no-clean --out-dir dist && tsup src/spd-score.ts --format esm --no-dts --no-clean --out-dir dist && tsup src/spd-score-cli.ts --format esm --no-dts --no-clean --out-dir dist && SPD_BUILD_TARGET=browser tsup src/browser.ts --format esm --dts --no-clean && node scripts/post-build.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npx vitest run --maxWorkers=2 && npm run build

author: spd-lib contributors
